name: Tapo C200 (EU)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only (802.11b/g/n); the datasheet lists no Ethernet port.

matter.note: The Tapo C200 pages we saw mention neither Matter nor HomeKit, and we found no CSA listing.

apple_home.note: No Tapo page we found lists Apple Home or HomeKit for the C200.

google_home.note: Tapo's C200 page says it works with Google Home. Tapo's FAQ describes streaming to a Chromecast or Google display, cloud-to-cloud, stopping after 10 minutes; the FAQ does not name the C200.

alexa.note: Tapo's C200 page says it works with Alexa. Tapo's Alexa FAQ says most Tapo cameras show live view only on Echo or Fire TV displays, for 10 minutes at a time, and cannot be switched on or off by voice. The FAQ lists only the C200 (V1) by name.

smartthings.note: No Tapo or Samsung page we found lists SmartThings for the C200.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's TP-Link integration page lists other Tapo cameras (C100, C120, C210 and more) but not the C200. It says unlisted devices may work.

hubRequired.note: Connects straight to home Wi-Fi; the spec sheet lists no hub compatibility, and Alexa links through the Tapo account with no hub or bridge.

localControl.note: RTSP and ONVIF are listed as supported, but Tapo does not say that app control works without the cloud.

cameraType.note: Tapo's Tapo Care page labels the C200 an indoor pan/tilt security camera. The German product page lists tabletop or ceiling mounting and no weather rating.

power.note: 9 V DC, 0.6 A adapter on 100-240 V mains; the datasheet gives a 3 m cord.

localStorage.note: microSD slot up to 512 GB, card sold separately. Tapo lists local storage among the features that work without Tapo Care.

subscription.value: Cloud clip history and rich notifications (Tapo Care)
subscription.note: Tapo says live view, instant notifications, two-way audio and local storage are free. Basic and Premium plans add 7-day or 30-day clip history. Plans vary by country; EU prices not checked.

summary: The Tapo C200 is a plug-in pan/tilt indoor camera with a microSD slot (up to 512 GB), which Tapo lists as free recording. Tapo says it works with Alexa and Google Home, and both links run through the Tapo app with no hub. Cloud clip history needs the optional Tapo Care plan. Apple Home, SmartThings and Home Assistant support are not confirmed.
caveats: Alexa and Google streams are cloud-to-cloud and stop after 10 minutes; you ask again to keep watching.
C200 and C200C are separate Tapo products with their own pages; this record covers the C200, which Tapo sells in several hardware versions from V1 to V5.
Tapo's Alexa FAQ names only the C200 (V1), so Alexa support on newer hardware versions rests on the product page.
